title: Extract an Arriving Tote at the Hospital Station Using Hospital HMI and Green Scanner
summary: When an AGV brings a tote to the Hospital Station, use the Hospital HMI to open the correct tote-extraction screen based on the status fields, scan the tote barcode with the green scanner to populate the Tote ID field, and then perform the task indicated by the status fields. If the tote is being returned into the system, place it on the induct side (left) and ensure it is flush against the end stops.
when_to_use: Use this procedure when an AGV arrives at the Hospital Station with a tote and you need to extract the tote using the Hospital HMI workflow (screen selection driven by status fields), scan the tote barcode with the green scanner, and then execute the task indicated by the status fields.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the Hospital HMI screen selection, scan the tote barcode with the green scanner, verify Tote ID population, and execute the task indicated by the status fields. Perform correct physical placement on the induct side (left) with flush positioning against end stops when returning a tote into the system.
safety_notes: If the Tote ID field does not populate after scanning, stop and escalate for assistance rather than proceeding with the task.
If the tote cannot be positioned flush against the induct-side end stops, stop and escalate for assistance.
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to the Hospital Station induct side (left) and end stops

system_preconditions: An AGV has brought a tote to the right side of the Hospital Station.

visual_references.description: Hospital Station layout diagram showing right side for AGV tote delivery/extraction, left side induct side, and induct-side end stops; also indicates green scanner location for barcode scanning.
Hospital HMI screen example showing Tote ID population via green scanner, Bar Code scan, Remove Tote button, and Extract Position Information (AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, Status from WCS).
Hospital HMI Remove Tote screen showing Tote ID and Barcode fields populated via green scanner and Confirm & Execute to remove tote from the system.
Hospital HMI No Read Bar Code screen showing Tote ID scanning, Expected ID, and Remove Tote button for cases where barcode cannot be scanned at the Operator Station.

steps.healthy_condition: Tote is at the right side of the Hospital Station ready for extraction.
steps.failure_condition: No tote is present at the Hospital Station right side (or the tote is not at the expected arrival/extraction position).

actions.label: Verify tote arrival position
actions.exact_action: Confirm an AGV has brought a tote to the right side of the Hospital Station.

steps.title: If returning tote into the system, place it on the induct side (left) flush against end stops
steps.purpose: Ensure correct physical placement for tote re-entry so the system can handle the tote properly.
steps.instruction: If the tote is going back into the system, put the tote on the induct side (left side) of the station and ensure it is flush against the end stops.
